crossRefs.note: But if we are afflicted, it is for your comfort and salvation. If we are comforted, it is for your comfort, which…
I wish that you would bear with me in a little foolishness, but indeed you do bear with me.
I say again, let no one think me foolish. But if so, yet receive me as foolish, that I also may boast a little.
That which I speak, I don’t speak according to the Lord, but as in foolishness, in this confidence of boasting.
Truly the signs of an apostle were worked among you in all perseverance, in signs and wonders and mighty works.
For I reckon that I am not at all behind the very best apostles.
For when one says, “I follow Paul,” and another, “I follow Apollos,” aren’t you fleshly?
whether Paul, or Apollos, or Cephas, or the world, or life, or death, or things present, or things to come. All are…
But from those who were reputed to be important—whatever they were, it makes no difference to me; God doesn’t show…
Even so you also, when you have done all the things that are commanded you, say, ‘We are unworthy servants. We have…
So then neither he who plants is anything, nor he who waters, but God who gives the increase.
and last of all, as to the child born at the wrong time, he appeared to me also.
To me, the very least of all saints, was this grace given, to preach to the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ,

translations.web: I have become foolish in boasting. You compelled me, for I ought to have been commended by you, for I am in no way inferior to the very best apostles, though I am nothing.
translations.bsb: I have become a fool, but you drove me to it. In fact, you should have commended me, since I am in no way inferior to those “super-apostles,” even though I am nothing.
translations.kjv: I am become a fool in glorying; ye have compelled me: for I ought to have been commended of you: for in nothing am I behind the very chiefest apostles, though I be nothing.
translations.asv: I am become foolish: ye compelled me; for I ought to have been commended of you: for in nothing was I behind the very chiefest apostles, though I am nothing.
